description: Returns the exact string to sign, with the correct next nonce, for a free instant transfer between two ENROLLED accounts. Signs nothing and moves nothing — the sender signs the returned message, then POSTs {from,to,amount,nonce,signature} to /api/netting/transfer. BOTH parties must already be enrolled: Robyn will not hold a balance for a recipient who never consented, so to pay an unenrolled address use the ordinary non-custodial route instead.
name: robyn_netting_transfer_payload
title: Build the message to sign for a FREE internal transfer
